title: int:StripePayment
description: Stripe-specific payment record linking internal Payment records to the Stripe PSP. Child of Payment.

stripeInvoiceId.description: Primary key. Unique Stripe invoice identifier. IRI: int:stripeInvoiceId.

paymentId.description: FK to internal Payment record. IRI: int:paymentId. UUID v4.

customerId.description: FK to customer Actor. IRI: int:customerId. UUID v4.

legalEntityId.description: FK to legal entity Actor. IRI: int:legalEntityId. UUID v4. Nullable.

billingEmail.description: Email address for receipt/invoice delivery. IRI: int:billingEmail. RFC 5321 format.

stripeInvoiceStatus.description: Stripe invoice lifecycle status. IRI: int:stripeInvoiceStatus.

stripeInvoiceAmountDue.description: Total amount due on the Stripe invoice in smallest currency unit. IRI: int:stripeInvoiceAmountDue.

stripeInvoiceCurrency.description: Currency of the Stripe invoice. IRI: int:stripeInvoiceCurrency. ISO 4217.

chargeAmount.description: Amount to charge in smallest currency unit. IRI: int:chargeAmount.

latestChargeId.description: Identifier of the latest Stripe Charge. IRI: int:latestChargeId.

paymentStatus.description: Stripe payment lifecycle status. IRI: int:paymentStatus.

receiptDeliveryStatus.description: Status of receipt delivery to customer. IRI: int:receiptDeliveryStatus.

failureReason.description: Simplified payment failure reason. IRI: int:failureReason. Nullable.

createdAt.description: Stripe payment object creation timestamp. IRI: int:createdAt. ISO 8601 with timezone.

updatedAt.description: Internal record last updated timestamp. IRI: int:updatedAt. ISO 8601 with timezone.
